  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Thursday, November 16, 2023, at 10:00 a.m.
1.  ROLL CALL
    The meeting was called to order on November 16, 2023, at 10:01 a.m.
    Present: Commissioners Vidor, Zadorian (arrived late to the meeting at 10:40 a.m.), Aleksandryan,
  Pogosian, Vice Chairperson Tufenkian, Chairperson Viar
    Absent: Commissioner Yank.
    The Agenda for the November 16, 2023, Regular Meeting was posted on November 13, 2023, on the
  Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

2. CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the Commission or the
  audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such request before motion is
  proposed.

  a. Minutes of the October 19, 2023 Arts and Culture Commission Meeting

  Moved:  Commissioner Vidor
  Seconded :  Vice-Chairperson Tufenkian

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vidor, Vice Chairperson Tufenkian, Chairperson Viar
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Yank
  Abstain:  Commissioners Zadorian, Aleksandryan, Pogosian

3. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Stephanie Sherwood, Exhibitions Coordinator
   Ms. Sherwood introduced herself to the Commission as the new Exhibitions Coordinator
  overseeing Reflect Space and Brand Library & Art Center galleries. Commission welcomed Ms.
  Sherwood.

  b. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Loreto Lopez, Program Coordinator
   Ms. Lopez gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale Library, Arts &
  Culture locations.

4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
  Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
  Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report. – None

5. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS – None

6. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Getty PST Art: Blended Worlds Exhibit - Artist Stipends
  1
   1. Motion approving the funding of artist stipends for the Getty PST Art: Blended Worlds
  exhibit with NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) at the Brand Library & Art Center, in
  an amount not to exceed $200,000 dispersed from the 2023-2024 Work Plan.

    Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave a brief introduction and presented a short video of the Getty PST Art
  initiative.
    David Delgado, Cultural Strategist for Lab Engagement of NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory
  (JPL), gave a brief presentation of the Blended Worlds Exhibit and its artists. The Commission
  asked questions and gave their input.

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves the funding of artist stipends for the Getty PST:
  Blended Worlds Exhibit with NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) at the Brand Library & Art Center,
  in an amount not to exceed $200,000 dispersed from the 2023-2024 Work Plan, as more fully outlined
  in the November 16, 2023 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture Administrator.

  Moved:  Commissioner Vidor
  Seconded :  Vice Chairperson Tufenkian

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vidor, Vice Chairperson Tufenkian, Chairperson Viar
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Yank
  Abstain:  Commissioners Zadorian, Aleksandryan, Pogosian

7. DISCUSSION ITEMS
  a. City-Wide Public Art - Request for Qualifications

    Ms. Fukutomi-Jones introduced Mr. Basse and stated that LeBasse Projects will be releasing
  the City-Wide Public Art – Request for Qualifications in November 2023. The Commission
  decided on 3 locations for consideration and LeBasse Projects prepared a Request for
  Qualifications and will be released on November 27th.

  b. 2023 – 2024 Work Plan Progress

    Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave several updates from the Work Plan that have had recent activity:

  CITY WIDE ARTS
  i.  Mural Ordinance – Update:
   Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that initial draft Mural Ordinance was shared with City Staff
  and is moving diligently, and the Commission will be apprised of the status of the final
  draft. She also stated that Staff is working with Beatify Earth coordinating a community
  input meeting.

  ii.  Creative Crosswalks - Update
   Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that the application for the Creative Crosswalks program will
  close on Friday, November 17th at 5:00pm.

MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS
  iii.  The ACE Agency – Update:
   Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that The ACE Agency is now under contract with the City and
  will be working with Staff to develop a marketing and communications strategic plan for the
  Commission’s review.

8. COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  2
     The Commission thanked Staff for all their hard work with the Arts and Culture
  Commission.
    Commissioner Vidor stated that she is excited about all the activities happening with Arts
  and Culture in Glendale and is glad she will be part of the Commission in the upcoming
  years.
    Commissioner Zadorian requested a budget update. Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated Staff
  will provide an update on the Urban Art Fund during a future Commission meeting.
    Student Commissioner Pogosian stopped by to look at the Beyond the Box Utility Boxes
  and thanked all the artists for their work.
    Chairperson Viar thanked Mr. James Lau (Executive Director, Glendale Library, Arts &
  Culture Trust) and Ms. Fukutomi-Jones for their collaboration with JPL on the Getty PST
  Art Initiative.
    Commissioner Vidor thanked Staff for the great public outreach on the Creative
  Crosswalks initiative.
    Ms. Fukutomi-Jones thanked Loreto Lopez and Celine Avedian for their work on the
  Creative Crosswalks initiative.

9. ADJOURNMENT: 11:07 a.m.
  The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is Thursday,
  December 21, 2023, at 10:00am at City Council Chambers – 613 E. Broadway (2 Floor)
  Glendale, CA 91206.
